buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 6. Generic IT equipment shall be IPv6 ready from day one. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. To qualify for participation, bidders are required to conduct a site visit and deliver a presentation on the proposed items/ solutions prior to the technical evaluation stage. 2. The Technical Evaluation Committee reserves the right to invite only those vendors who meet the essen tial eligibility parameters for further project clarification and technical presentations. 3. Only vendors with valid registration and demonstrated experience in projects with the Indian Army will b e considered eligible to participate in the bidding process. 4. A sample presentation and demonstration of the proposed technical services will be conducted after the bid opening. Bidders are advised to present their sample demonstration for technical qualification within 4 8 hours from the commencement of the technical evaluation process. .
